summaries.name: Mahaulepu Heritage Trail
summaries.summary: A 4-mile out-and-back hiking trail on Kauai's southeastern coast. Takes hikers through a lush forest, along the coastline, and to scenic lookout points. Sea turtles, monk seals, and whales (seasonally) can be spotted along the trail.

summaries.name: Loco Moco
summaries.summary: A classic Hawaiian comfort food dish featuring a hamburger patty, fried egg, and gravy, all served over a bed of rice.

summaries.name: Shave Ice
summaries.summary: A sweet Hawaiian treat made from shaved ice and flavored syrups.

summaries.name: Hanalei Bay
summaries.summary: A picturesque bay on Kauai that is a favorite spot for snorkeling and swimming with sea turtles. Its calm waters and coral reefs provide a habitat for turtles.

summaries.name: Kauai Kayak and Snorkel
summaries.summary: A snorkeling tour operator on Kauai recommended for helping visitors spot sea turtles and monk seals.
